title: Elon
description: Ruler of Israel. Person record added by the CFAH pass from the per-king rows of the OSF preprint CFAH-14 (Table 5, "CFAH Reconstructed Eponym List (CFAH-REL)"); its dates are display only.

sorting_basis.note: No tier gives a birth year.

standby.note: Standby placement only. Chronological Framework of Ancient History prints this BC/AD year on the reign entry (Column: Ruler of Israel; Name row (Year BC): 1139; Last regnal-year row (Year BC): 1130 (year 10)). It is not a sort year. No Anno Mundi, regnal length, or Julian Period figure was converted to obtain it.

reign.date: Column: Ruler of Israel; Name row (Year BC): 1139; Last regnal-year row (Year BC): 1130 (year 10)
reign.citation: Griffith & White, "CFAH-14: Ancient Assyria," OSF preprint v1.0 (27 Feb 2026), doi:10.17605/OSF.IO/9FUW2, file CFAH-14_Assyria_v_1.0.pdf, Table 5 "CFAH Reconstructed Eponym List (CFAH-REL)", pp. 55–56
reign.note: Row "Elon" of Table 5 (Israel). Year-by-year table (1262-963 BC). A ruler's name is printed in one year row and his regnal-year numbers in the following rows; each row here gives the Year BC of the name row and of the last numbered row, as printed. No year is computed from a length.

reign.citation: Raleigh, The History of the World (1617, EEBO-TCP A10357), Chronological Table, sig. 786a
reign.note: Year cell "3515 2833 320". The third printed figure 320 is the column "Exodus", not a length. To the Reader (sig. 780b): the Julian Period exceeds the yeere of the World by 682. The 10 at the end of the name is the reign length he prints. The end year is not printed on this row. Column: Israel..
